x126.name_fr: L'habit ne fait pas le templier
x126.description_en: Obtain a complete set of templar armor consisting of a templar's chain coif, a templar's haubergeon, and a pair of templar's sollerets.※Speak to Jonathas in Old Gridania with all three items equipped.
